local.setIn: Set in the Philippines. All amounts are in Philippine pesos.

high.label: Grand church wedding
high.diary: We had a grand church wedding and a hotel reception. Our ninongs and ninangs filled the pews.

mid.label: Church wedding + reception
mid.diary: We had a church wedding and a reception with family and friends.

low.label: Civil wedding + salo-salo
low.diary: We had a civil wedding and a simple salo-salo at home.

wedding.skip: We skipped the ceremony and shared a quiet toast, just the two of us.

high.label: Japan
high.diary: Honeymoon in Japan. We walked under the autumn leaves hand in hand.

mid.label: Palawan
mid.diary: Honeymoon in Palawan. The lagoons were unreal.

low.label: Tagaytay
low.diary: A short honeymoon in Tagaytay. Bulalo and the cool breeze.

honeymoon.skip: We skipped the honeymoon. "Someday," we promised.

high.diary: We decided we'd both work full-time.

mid.diary: My partner switched to shorter hours / part-time.

low.diary: My partner left work to focus on home.

high.label: SUV
high.diary: We bought a big SUV. The whole family fits, with room for pasalubong.

mid.label: New sedan
mid.diary: We bought a new sedan. Weekend drives became our joy.

low.label: Used car
low.diary: We bought a used car. A bit old, but it runs fine.

car.skip: We didn't buy a car. Jeepneys, the MRT and Grab will do.
car.never: We decided to live without a car.

high.label: Yaya + private preschool
high.diary: We hired a yaya and enrolled our child in a private preschool.

mid.label: Neighborhood preschool
mid.diary: We found a good preschool in the neighborhood.

low.label: Lolo and lola
low.diary: Lolo and lola will look after them. They're thrilled.

high.label: Exclusive school
high.diary: Started at an exclusive private school. The uniform looks great.

mid.label: Private school
mid.diary: Started at a private school nearby.

low.label: Public school
low.diary: Started at the public elementary school. The backpack looks huge.

high.label: Exclusive school
high.diary: Moved up to junior high at the exclusive school.

mid.label: Private school
mid.diary: Started junior high at a private school.

low.label: Public school
low.diary: Started junior high at the public school. Totally into basketball.

high.label: Exclusive school
high.diary: Started senior high at the exclusive school.

mid.label: Private school
mid.diary: Started senior high at a private school, in the STEM strand.

low.label: Public school
low.diary: Started senior high at the public school.

high.label: Top university, dorm
high.diary: Got into a top private university and moved into a dorm. ({years} yrs)

mid.label: Private university
mid.diary: Went to a private university. ({years} yrs)

low.label: State university
low.diary: Passed the entrance exam for a state university. ({years} yrs)

university.skip: Started work after senior high. A working adult now.

high.label: House in a gated village
high.diary: We bought a house in a gated village. We talked over the floor plan again and again.

mid.label: Condo in the city
mid.diary: We bought a condo in the city. No more long commutes.

low.label: Pre-owned house + renovation
low.diary: We bought a pre-owned house and renovated it. Old, but full of charm.

house.skip: We didn't buy; we rented a bigger place.
house.never: We decided to rent for life. Traveling light is best.
house.majorRepair: The old house's roof and plumbing gave out. Major renovation cost {cost:money}.

high.label: Full renovation
high.diary: We renovated the whole house. That'll hold for a while.

low.label: Quick fix
low.diary: We patched it up for now.

high.label: Trip abroad
high.diary: We took a family trip abroad.

mid.label: Beach trip
mid.diary: We took a family trip to the beach in the provinces.

low.label: Day trip nearby
low.diary: We went on a day trip nearby. Still fun.

familyTrip.skip: We spent this year's anniversary relaxing at home.

S.comment: No more money worries. Let's go wherever we always wanted, whenever we like.

A.comment: Hobbies and travel to enjoy. We can laugh and say, "We did well."

B.comment: No luxuries, but no troubles either. Calm days go on.

C.comment: The SSS pension alone feels thin. We'll get by together, saving where we can.

D.comment: We'll keep working a while. While we're able, that's not so bad.

bankrupt.comment: Debts piled up and our finances collapsed. Look back at where we overreached, and try again.
